title: Act: Remove duplicate world.ts module
summary: Delete src/content/world.ts so loader.ts is the only loader and validator.
description: Context: world.ts is only imported by tests/validator.test.ts; no src file imports it. Desired behavior: delete it. The surviving loader.ts validateWorld(world: LoadedWorld) already reports unknown scene (start scene and goto_scene), character (say and speaker), flag (set_flag, openWhenFlag, conditions) and object (discover) references. Expected result: no code path references content/world.
definition_of_done: world.ts removed; grep for content/world in src returns nothing

steps.action: Delete the whole file with `git rm backend/game/src/content/world.ts`; do not edit loader.ts in this step.
steps.expected: File is absent and no src file references it.
